name: adspeeder
description: Speeds up and mutes video ads, then restores your exact playback state.

scripts.build: npm run build:chrome && npm run build:firefox && npm run build:edge
scripts.build:safari: wxt build -b safari && xcrun safari-web-extension-converter .output/safari-mv3 --project-location safari --app-name AdSpeeder --no-open --force
scripts.zip: wxt zip -b chrome && wxt zip -b firefox --mv3 && wxt zip -b edge
